product_overview: Bookly Travel is a multilingual tour marketplace where travelers discover and book tours, manage bookings and wishlists, and read travel content. Tour partners can onboard, manage listings, pricing, availability, bookings, reviews, and analytics through a dedicated portal.
core_goals: Help travelers search for tours by destination, category, date, and other filters
Let travelers view tour details and complete bookings with payment
Allow travelers to manage bookings, vouchers, wishlists, reviews, and profile settings
Enable partners to register, access onboarding, and manage their tour business operations
Provide a public travel blog for reading destination and tour content

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Travelers can create accounts, sign in, recover passwords, and access protected areas after authentication.
user_flows: Navigate to /en/auth/register -> Fill in name, email, and password -> Submit the registration form -> See validation feedback or account creation outcome
Navigate to /en/auth/login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the sign-in form -> Get redirected after successful login
Navigate to /en/auth/login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See an invalid-credentials message
Navigate to /en/auth/forgot-password -> Fill in email -> Submit the password reset request -> See a success message that a reset link was sent
Navigate to /en/auth/reset-password -> Enter the reset token and new password -> Submit the reset form -> See the password update complete

features.name: Homepage Browsing and Discovery
features.description: Visitors can explore featured tours, destinations, and categories from the homepage and move into search or tour detail pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /en -> Enter a destination or keyword in the search experience -> Submit the search -> See matching tour results
Navigate to /en -> Open a featured tour -> See the tour detail page
Navigate to /en -> Open a destination card -> See tours filtered by destination
Navigate to /en -> Open a category card -> See tours filtered by category

features.name: Tour Search and Filtering
features.description: Visitors can search the tour catalog, refine results with filters, change sorting, and page through matching tours.
user_flows: Navigate to /en/search -> Enter a search query -> Apply filters such as date, participants, and price -> Change the sort order -> See updated results
Navigate to /en/search -> Move to the next results page -> See a new set of matching tours
Navigate to /en/search -> Apply filters that return no matches -> See an empty-state message

features.name: Tour Detail
features.description: Visitors can review a tour's gallery, description, pricing, reviews, and booking availability before starting checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to /en/tours/hidden-gems-rome-walking-tour -> Browse the gallery -> Read the description and highlights -> Review pricing and available information
Navigate to /en/tours/hidden-gems-rome-walking-tour -> Read traveler reviews -> See aggregate rating and review content
Navigate to /en/tours/hidden-gems-rome-walking-tour -> Select a date and participant count -> Start booking from the tour page
Navigate to /en/tours/hidden-gems-rome-walking-tour -> Try to save the tour as a wishlist item while not signed in -> See a login requirement

features.name: Booking Checkout and Confirmation
features.description: Travelers and guests can reserve a tour, provide contact details, complete payment, and receive a booking confirmation and reference.
user_flows: Navigate to /en/booking -> Select a tour date and participant count -> Fill in contact details -> Submit the booking form -> Enter card details in the payment step -> Confirm payment -> See the confirmation page with a booking reference
Navigate to /en/booking -> Select a sold-out date -> Attempt to continue the booking -> See an availability conflict message before payment
Navigate to /en/booking -> Review the booking summary -> Complete payment -> See the confirmation page and payment status
Navigate to /v/BK-EXAMPLE -> View the public booking lookup page -> See booking validity information

features.name: Traveler Bookings
features.description: Authenticated travelers can view their booking history, open booking details, download vouchers, and cancel eligible bookings.
user_flows: Navigate to /en/my-bookings -> View the bookings list with status badges -> Open a booking detail -> See full booking information
Navigate to /en/my-bookings -> Open a booking detail -> Download the voucher -> Receive the PDF voucher file
Navigate to /en/my-bookings -> Open an eligible booking detail -> Cancel the booking -> Confirm the cancellation -> See the updated booking status
Navigate to /en/my-bookings -> Open a booking detail that is inside the cancellation window -> See cancellation disabled

features.name: Wishlist
features.description: Authenticated travelers can save tours for later, review saved tours, and remove items from the wishlist.
user_flows: Navigate to /en/wishlist -> View saved tours in a grid -> Open a saved tour -> See the tour detail page
Navigate to /en/tours/hidden-gems-rome-walking-tour -> Save the tour to the wishlist after signing in -> See the saved state update
Navigate to /en/wishlist -> Remove a tour from the wishlist -> See it disappear from the saved tours list

features.name: Traveler Profile and Password Management
features.description: Authenticated travelers can view and edit profile details, update locale preference, and change their password.
user_flows: Navigate to /en/profile -> Edit name and locale preference -> Save changes -> See the updated profile information
Navigate to /en/profile -> Fill in current password and new password -> Submit the change-password form -> See the password update outcome

features.name: Traveler Reviews
features.description: Authenticated travelers can view their submitted reviews and edit eligible reviews within the allowed time window.
user_flows: Navigate to /en/my-reviews -> View submitted reviews -> Open a review for editing -> Change the rating and comment -> Save the updated review
Navigate to /en/tours/hidden-gems-rome-walking-tour -> Read visible reviews -> See the traveler feedback on the tour page

features.name: Partner Onboarding
features.description: Partners can register, accept invitations, and view onboarding status before gaining access to the partner workspace.
user_flows: Navigate to /en/auth/partner-register -> Fill in company and account details -> Submit the registration form -> See onboarding status
Navigate to /en/partner-invite/INVITE_TOKEN -> Review the invitation details -> Complete registration -> See the partner account setup finish
Navigate to /en/partner/onboarding -> View approval status -> See whether the partner workspace is available or still gated
Navigate to /en/partner/onboarding -> Resubmit updated partner profile information -> See the updated onboarding submission

features.name: Partner Dashboard
features.description: Approved partners can access the partner workspace overview, metrics, and business status information.
user_flows: Navigate to /en/partner -> View dashboard metrics and business summary -> Review partner workspace status

features.name: Partner Tour Management
features.description: Approved partners can create, edit, archive, and manage tour listings, pricing, and availability.
user_flows: Navigate to /en/partner/tours -> View the tour list and status values -> Open a tour for editing -> Update details -> Save changes
Navigate to /en/partner/tours/create -> Fill in the multi-field tour form -> Create a new tour -> See the tour added to the list
Navigate to /en/partner/tours/[id]/pricing -> Review pricing tiers -> Add or update a tier -> Save pricing changes
Navigate to /en/partner/tours/[id]/availability -> Review the availability calendar -> Add or update availability rules or exceptions -> Save changes
Navigate to /en/partner/tours -> Select a tour -> Archive it -> See the tour status change

features.name: Partner Bookings and Status Updates
features.description: Partners can review incoming bookings, inspect booking details, and update booking status.
user_flows: Navigate to /en/partner/bookings -> View the bookings list with filters -> Open a booking detail -> See traveler and booking information
Navigate to /en/partner/bookings -> Open a booking detail -> Update the booking status -> See the new status reflected in the booking record

features.name: Partner Reviews and Responses
features.description: Partners can review feedback left on their tours and publish public responses.
user_flows: Navigate to /en/partner/reviews -> View received reviews -> Open a review -> Write a public response -> Submit the response
Navigate to /en/partner/reviews -> View an existing response thread -> Update the response -> See the revised public reply

features.name: Partner Analytics
features.description: Partners can inspect business performance metrics and charts over selected date ranges.
user_flows: Navigate to /en/partner/analytics -> Select a date range -> View booking and revenue metrics -> Review the charts

features.name: Partner Profile and Settings
features.description: Partners can view and update company profile details and operational settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /en/partner/profile -> Edit company profile information -> Save changes -> See updated profile details
Navigate to /en/partner/profile -> Open settings -> Update operational preferences -> Save settings -> See the updated configuration

features.name: Blog and Travel Insights
features.description: Visitors can browse travel articles, filter by category, open article detail pages, and preview draft content when provided access.
user_flows: Navigate to /en/blog -> Browse the article listing -> Move through pagination -> Open a post -> Read the article detail page
Navigate to /en/blog -> Select a category filter -> See the listing update to matching articles
Navigate to /en/blog/category/[slug] -> View posts in a blog category -> Open a post -> Read the article
Navigate to /en/blog/[slug]/preview -> Open a draft preview link with a valid token -> Read the unpublished article preview

known_limitations.issue: Stripe publishable key is a placeholder (pk_test_placeholder) in frontend .env.local
known_limitations.impact: The Stripe PaymentElement step of checkout cannot load real card fields; booking creation up to the payment step works, full payment completion requires valid Stripe test keys

known_limitations.issue: Seeded catalog is minimal (3 tours, 1 published - hidden-gems-rome-walking-tour)
known_limitations.impact: Search, homepage and category pages show limited data; use slug hidden-gems-rome-walking-tour for tour detail and booking tests

known_limitations.issue: Email delivery is not configured in local Docker
known_limitations.impact: Forgot-password and email-verification flows cannot complete via real email link; only the request step is testable

known_limitations.issue: Partner registration requires admin approval (onboarding status)
known_limitations.impact: Newly registered partners may be gated at onboarding; use seeded partner@bookly.test for partner-area tests
